Write the agent documents: an AGENTS.md block and a Claude skill

Source: R/use-agent-docs.R
use_agent_docs.Rd

Writes, under the project root, .claude/skills/weft/SKILL.md and a block in AGENTS.md (created when absent) that tell a coding agent the rules of a weft project: a failed claim is a finding to report, a check is never changed to make a render pass, a commit that removes constructs carries the Weft-Removed trailer, and values for one chapter go in dict_local.

Usage

use_agent_docs(path = ".", overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

path

A directory in the project.

overwrite

Replace a block or skill weft wrote that has since been edited.

Value

The paths written, invisibly (character() when nothing changed).

Details

The block sits between <!-- weft:start ... --> and <!-- weft:end --> lines, appended after the file's last line with one blank line before it; the rest of the file is never touched. The start line and the skill's last line carry the weft version and a hash. A block or skill weft wrote and nobody edited is replaced when its text would differ; an edited one is left as it is unless overwrite = TRUE; a SKILL.md with no weft line is another author's and is never replaced. When CLAUDE.md exists and does not hold @AGENTS.md, the call says to add that line. It says what it will write first. suppressMessages() silences it.
